video_summary.overall_goal: Inspect nearby Wi-Fi networks, view channel information, open network details, and try exporting or sharing channel graph data.
video_summary.description: The recording shows a WiFiAnalyzer app. The user moves from the Access Points list to Channel Rating, then to Channel Graph, taps a network graph to view details, opens the navigation drawer, selects Export, and opens the Android share sheet.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: A Wi-Fi access points list is visible with nearby networks, signal strength values, channels, frequencies, security labels, and a bottom navigation bar.
visible_ui_elements: Wi-Fi scan throttling is enabled message
steps.system_response: The app remains on the Access Points screen.
steps.visual_feedback: The Access Points tab is selected.
steps.intent_task: View nearby Wi-Fi networks and their signal details.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: The Access Points list is still visible with the bottom navigation bar.
steps.system_response: The app switches to the Channel Rating screen.
steps.navigation_change: Access Points screen changes to Channel Rating screen.
steps.visual_feedback: The Channel Rating tab becomes selected.
steps.intent_task: Check which Wi-Fi channels are recommended or crowded.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: A channel rating table is visible with star ratings, channel numbers, and access point counts.
steps.system_response: The app switches to the Channel Graph screen.
steps.navigation_change: Channel Rating screen changes to Channel Graph screen.
steps.visual_feedback: The Channel Graph tab becomes selected.
steps.intent_task: View Wi-Fi networks visually by channel and signal strength.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: A graph shows multiple nearby Wi-Fi networks as colored channel blocks. The vertical axis shows signal strength and the horizontal axis shows Wi-Fi channels.
visible_ui_elements: Wi-Fi scan throttling is enabled message
steps.target_element: A Wi-Fi network block on the channel graph
steps.system_response: The app prepares to show details for the selected Wi-Fi network.
steps.visual_feedback: The tapped graph area is touched and the selected network area is targeted.
steps.intent_task: Inspect more details about a specific Wi-Fi network shown on the graph.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: A details popup is shown over the channel graph with information for a selected network named ThodaSaSignal.
steps.system_response: A popup with network details appears.
steps.visual_feedback: The background graph is dimmed and the network details popup appears.
steps.intent_task: Read detailed information about the selected Wi-Fi network.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: The Channel Graph screen is visible again without the details popup.
visible_ui_elements: Wi-Fi scan throttling is enabled message
steps.visual_feedback: The popup disappears and the graph becomes fully visible again.
steps.intent_task: Return to the main channel graph view after checking network details.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: The Channel Graph screen is visible with the hamburger menu icon in the top-left corner.
steps.system_response: The navigation drawer opens from the left side.
steps.visual_feedback: A side menu slides in over the graph.
steps.intent_task: Open the app menu to access more options.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: The side navigation drawer is open with WiFiAnalyzer app name and menu options.
steps.system_response: The app begins the export action.
steps.navigation_change: navigation drawer remains briefly visible before export/share UI appears
steps.intent_task: Export the current Wi-Fi scan or channel graph data.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: The Channel Graph screen is visible again after selecting Export.
visible_ui_elements: Wi-Fi scan throttling is enabled message
steps.system_response: The app processes the export request.
steps.visual_feedback: The app returns to the graph view before opening the share interface.
steps.intent_task: Wait for the export/share option to load.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: The Android share sheet appears over the WiFiAnalyzer app. It shows export text, a file name, and sharing destinations.
steps.system_response: The Android share interface opens with sharing options.
steps.visual_feedback: The lower share panel overlays the app.
steps.intent_task: Choose where to copy or share the exported Wi-Fi data.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: The share sheet is no longer visible and the Channel Graph screen is shown again.
visible_ui_elements: Wi-Fi scan throttling is enabled message
steps.system_response: The share sheet closes and the app returns to the channel graph.
steps.visual_feedback: A small loading indicator appears briefly on the graph.
steps.intent_task: Exit the sharing interface and return to the graph view.

overall_flow: The user starts on the Access Points list.
The user opens Channel Rating to view channel quality information.
The user opens Channel Graph to view nearby Wi-Fi networks visually.
The user taps a network on the graph to inspect details.
The user closes the details popup.
The user opens the navigation drawer.
The Android share sheet opens with sharing options.
The user exits the share sheet and returns to the Channel Graph screen.
human_readable_step_summary: Step 1: The app opens on the Access Points screen and shows nearby Wi-Fi networks.
Step 2: The user taps Channel Rating to check Wi-Fi channel ratings.
Step 3: The user taps Channel Graph to see the networks on a graph.
Step 4: The user taps a network block on the graph.
Step 5: The app opens a popup with details about the selected Wi-Fi network.
Step 6: The user closes the network details popup and returns to the graph.
Step 7: The user taps the menu icon to open the side menu.
Step 8: The user taps Export from the side menu.
Step 9: The app returns to the graph while preparing the export.
Step 10: The Android share sheet opens so the user can copy or share the exported data.
Step 11: The user closes the share sheet and returns to the Channel Graph screen.
